name: devdeskchat-monorepo
description: DevDeskChat monorepo — backend (NestJS), frontend (React+Vite), shared contracts (Zod).

scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm --workspace @devdeskchat/backend run build && npm --workspace devdeskchat-frontend run build
